title: ID0385127-DC/Si-D/AT -[pHAdNC] Charging not started & Unable to rollout FW
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
1. screensavers are no longer displayed on the station. However, these were already working and were installed directly by Biedermann Benjamin. (see video) 2. charging start not possible: see video, the charging station does not show on the display whether the card has been read, does not show the authentication, does not show the charging start. According to the logs (see photos), however, a charging process was started, but without power. After a short time, the car goes into fault mode. 3. Update not possible: An update to 4.011 is currently not possible due to an SCB error (affects all charging stations). The firmware is not being rolled out.
Root cause:  RFID card reader faulty
Solution: RFID reader replaced -> works. H&S wiring according to Tesch Lea description -> works
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:  NO
Warranty Status: ACTIVE
